Permits & License Committee  November 22, 2023

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  November 22, 2023

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 850 9610 5346 and Password 990440 on November 22, 2023 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna / Christine Rivera , Planning Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services/ Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on November 07, 2023.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Tim McNeff on behalf of Kia Forum to host a Tree Lighting Event at 3900 W. Manchester
  Blvd., Kia Forum, Private Property, on Tuesday, November 28, 2023, from 5:00 p.m. - 8:00
  p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Applicant to hire a adequate professional / Licensed security guards for the safety of
  attendees and employees; All Securtiy Guards/ Event Staff shall wear reflective vests; A
  Watch Commander will be notified and extra patrol will be provided if time permits.
  Applicant must comply to Code enforcement requirements for any code violations identified
  and adhere to IMC Chapter 5 Article 2- Noise Regulations; Maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene
  and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00365050)
